summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the change does and how well its behaviors are tested.

tests_read.description: The test files read while looking, relative to the repository root. Empty when none were found.

gaps.description: Behaviors the change introduces that no test would notice breaking, highest priority first. Empty when there are none.

priority.description: high = wrong results or lost data would ship unnoticed; medium = an edge case or an error path; low = cosmetic.

file.description: The file holding the behavior, relative to the repository root, or 'input'.

location.description: A line range when known, otherwise the function or rule's name.

behavior.description: The one behavior that is untested, stated so a test could be written from it.

suggested_test.description: A test name in the project's own style.

human_summary.description: Written LAST. A short note for the author in Markdown: the coverage in plain words, then the gaps worth closing first.
